title: Pay $79 once for an AI platform that lets you write, humanize, detect, and polish
content_html:
TL;DR: Get lifetime access to UmanWrite’s Unlimited Plan for a one-time $79 (reg. $1,799).

Credit: UmanWrite

$79
$1,799 Save $1,720

Getting AI to write something is easy. Getting it to write something that actually sounds like you? That’s where things get more interesting.

For a limited time, the UmanWrite All-in-One AI Writing Platform Unlimited Plan is $79 for lifetime access, down from its $1,799 list price. It combines writing, editing, humanizing, and AI detection in one workspace, with unlimited monthly word generation.

One of its biggest tricks is learning your personal writing style. Feed UmanWrite samples of your work, and you can train unlimited Voice Profiles that help future drafts better match your tone, vocabulary, and style. It also learns from your edits over time.

There are plenty of ways to make UmanWrite work for you:

  • AI Humanizer: Rewrites AI-generated content into more natural, human-sounding copy.

  • AI Detector: Run unlimited checks for AI-generated patterns before publishing.

  • Context-aware writing: Adapts drafts to your specific audience, purpose, and writing style.

  • Advanced Grammar Checker: Improves grammar, clarity, and readability.

  • Unlimited Voice Profiles: Train different profiles using your own writing samples.

  • Writing Studio: Write, edit, review, and organize drafts in one workspace.

UmanWrite can handle up to 2,500 words per request, and you can access it through modern desktop and mobile browsers.

That makes it useful for everything from SEO articles and newsletters to emails, social posts, marketing copy, academic content, and business documents.

Rather than accepting whatever generic AI voice appears in the first draft, UmanWrite gives you tools to shape it around your purpose — and, more importantly, your own voice.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

And with unlimited monthly words included in the lifetime plan, you can keep writing without watching a monthly word counter.

For this price, that’s a lot of room to sound less like AI and more like yourself. Get lifetime access to UmanWrite’s Unlimited Plan for a one-time $79 (reg. $1,799).

StackSocial prices subject to change.
